map.五子棋适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Gomoku best for?
map.15x15 标准棋盘，支持双人对战和AI模式: 15x15 standard board, supports two-player and AI mode
map.黑棋先手，双方轮流在棋盘交叉点落子: Black moves first; players alternately place stones on line intersections
map.任一方在横、竖、斜方向连成五子即获胜: Whoever connects five stones horizontally, vertically or diagonally wins
map.棋盘下满未分胜负则为平局: A full board with no winner is a draw
map.AI 模式使用启发式评估算法，识别活四、冲四、活三、眠三等棋型并计算最优落子位置: AI mode uses a heuristic evaluation algorithm, recognizing open-four, four-threat, open-three, sleeping-three patterns and computing the best move.
map.点击棋盘交叉点即可落子: Click a board intersection to place a stone
map.最后一手用红色方框标记: The last move is marked with a red square
map.人机模式下 AI 自动执白棋: In AI mode the AI automatically plays white
map.双人对战：在 15×15 标准棋盘轮流落子，先连成五子者胜。: Two-player: take turns placing stones on a 15x15 board; first to connect five wins.
map.AI 练习：单人挑战启发式 AI，练进攻与防守。: AI practice: challenge the heuristic AI solo to train offense and defense.
map.算法演示：理解活四、活三、冲四等棋型评估，适合讲解博弈搜索。: Algorithm demo: understand open-four, open-three, four-threat pattern evaluation, suited to explaining game-tree search.
map.15×15 棋盘（225 个交叉点），黑白轮流落子，横/竖/斜任意方向先连成 5: A 15x15 board (225 intersections), black and white alternate; first to connect 5 stones in any direction wins; an open-four (four-in-a-row with both ends open) cannot be blocked by the opponent and is a guaranteed win. The simplified version has no forbidden moves, so first player (black) has a clear edge.
map.黑棋 (7,7) 起手，白棋阻 (7,8)；黑续 (7,9)(7,10) 形成: Black opens at (7,7), white blocks (7,8); black continues (7,9)(7,10) to form the five-in-a-row (7,7)->(7,11) and wins. If white preemptively blocks at (7,6), black shifts to (8,7) to create an open-three in another direction. The first player should actively build double open-threes to force the opponent to split defense.
map.为什么总输给先手？: Why do I keep losing to the first player?
map.无禁手规则下黑棋先手且可抢中心，优势大；后手宜早做活三牵制、避免被冲四。: Without forbidden-move rules, black moves first and can seize the center, a big advantage; the second player should build open-threes early to contain and avoid getting four-threatened.
map.正式比赛黑棋有禁手（双三/双四/长连）；本工具为休闲版，未强制禁手，以连五为唯一: In formal play black has forbidden moves (double-three/double-four/overline); this tool is a casual version with no enforced forbidden moves, where five-in-a-row is the sole win condition.
